user.title: Watch your plugs
user.description: Look through your smart plugs and suggest which to watch, or pick any power sensor yourself.

menu_options.manual: Pick a power sensor by hand

pick.title: Which plugs should be watched?
pick.description: Each line sums up the last 10 days. Ticked: appliances that cycle like a compressor (fridge, freezer, dehumidifier), names like a fridge, and plugs that have drawn close to their rating. Short start spikes, like a compressor starting, don't count. Settings are guessed per plug; check them later under Configure, especially the plug rating.

data_description.notify_targets: Used for every plug picked here. Without any, findings only show under Settings > Repairs.

manual.title: Pick a power sensor
manual.description: Any power sensor, for example a plug the guard didn't recognise. Its history is used to learn what is normal, so watching starts right away.

details.title: About this appliance
details.description: Filled in from the plug and its history (suggested type: {profile}). Check the plug rating against the plug itself.

data.name: Name
data.critical: Critical: must keep running (fridge, freezer, network)

data_description.rating_w: The most the plug is made to switch, per socket, from its label or spec sheet: e.g. 2500 W for a Shelly Plug S. Rated in amps? Multiply by 230: 10 A = 2300 W, 12 A = 2760 W, 16 A = 3680 W. Leave empty to skip the rating check.
data_description.relay_entity: Lets Appliance Guard notice the plug switching itself off or coming back off after a power cut, and offer Cut power / Turn back on.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify services of the HA Companion app. Without any, findings only show under Settings > Repairs.
data_description.critical: Cycling: a long pause is an alarm. Leave off for appliances that only run when needed, like a dehumidifier: a long pause is then fine while it shows signs of life, such as its fan. Always on: stopping is an alarm, and switching it off from Home Assistant gives a notice.
data_description.keep_on: Turn the plug back on by itself when it switches itself off or comes back off after a power cut, then tell you. Never right after it was over its rating, and at most 3 times an hour. Useful for network gear, whose alarm may not reach you while it is off.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already watched.

progress.scan: Scanning your smart plugs and reading 10 days of history for each. This can take a minute.

create_entry.picked: Watching {count} plugs: {names}. Each has its own entry under Appliance Guard; check its settings under Configure.
